features.name: Consent-based video interview review
features.description: Optional recording review, timestamps, and transcript alignment for interviewers.

features.name: Emotion detection
features.description: Do not infer emotions, honesty, confidence, or personality from facial expressions or voice for hiring decisions.
acceptance_criteria: no emotion score is generated or stored

features.name: Real-time interview feedback
features.description: Optional practice-mode feedback on answer structure, relevance to a rubric, and technical concepts.
acceptance_criteria: candidate sees why feedback was provided

features.name: AI coaching system
features.description: Creates practice plans, sample questions, and learning activities from job-related skill gaps.
guardrails: coaching usage is not a hiring score
acceptance_criteria: every suggestion maps to a role skill
no unsupported claims about candidate ability

features.name: Candidate improvement suggestions
features.description: Identifies missing target skills and suggests practical learning actions.
guardrails: based only on supplied skills and role requirements
acceptance_criteria: each missing skill has a concrete next step

features.name: Interview analytics dashboard
features.description: Shows stage completion, rubric coverage, review latency, and reviewer disagreement at aggregate level.

roadmap.name: Candidate coaching MVP
exit_criteria: Candidate can view and correct profile data
No hiring decisions based on coaching usage

roadmap.name: Consent-based video workflow pilot
exit_criteria: No facial emotion or personality inference

skills_to_practice.suggestion: Practice SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, filtering, and window-function questions.
Build a small dashboard and explain why each chart fits the question.

coaching_prototype.summary: 2 target skill(s) identified for optional practice.
coaching_prototype.note: This plan is advisory and must not be used to rank or reject a candidate. Verify the input profile with the candidate.

limitations: The coaching prototype uses transparent rules and supplied skill lists; it is not a trained AI model.
Video analysis is proposed as an optional consent-based workflow, not implemented here.
Emotion or personality inference is excluded from hiring decisions.
The roadmap is a proposal and requires privacy, security, legal, accessibility, and stakeholder review.
